verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's own docs say it screens customers against adverse media and lets analysts review alerts and risks in Mesh case management or via the API, recording decisions such as 'risk detected - accepted'. Nothing in the evidence shows that adverse-media matches come with linked source evidence (articles or URLs) or are classified into risk categories. Missing for 10: documentation of linked evidence or source articles on adverse-media hits, adverse-media risk-category taxonomy, an adverse-media-specific review workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
